blocks.text: Keysville Town Council Budget Work Session
The Keysville Town Council held a budget work session at 6:00 p.m. on Wednesday, April 30, 2025 at the Keysville Town Office with the following present:
Council Members Absent: Mr. Scotty Jackson
During the work session, several adjustments were proposed to the upcoming 2025-2026 budget. No action was taken.

The town clerk, Sherry Marker, was instructed to retype the budget proposal with the new numbers and create a synopsis and advertise it in the paper along with a public hearing notice for the May 12, 2025 council meeting.
The budget work session ended at 9:00 p.m.
Sherry L. Marker, Town Clerk Robert Schaefer, Mayor
